text: Myth... a great idea sells itself.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Fact... a great idea makes enemies. Machiavelli knew it in fifteen thirteen.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Maya, new on her team, finds a way to do the weekly report in half the time.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The people who built the old way push back. The people it helps... just shrug.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He wrote... the innovator has for enemies all those who have done well under the old conditions, and lukewarm defenders in those who may do well under the new.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Two groups. One has something to lose. The other... doesn't believe it yet.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: In essence... people don't trust new things until they've lived with them a long time.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: My take? Stop pouring your energy into the critics. Win the shruggers... with proof, not speeches.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Maya quietly runs her method for one week... then shows the hours saved. Now the shruggers defend it.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Today, build the smallest version of your idea that works... and show one person it helps.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: What change did people fight you on? Tell me below.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
